subject: general
question: Which of the following organisation completed the 50th year of their establishment in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ISRO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) was founded on August 15, 1969, by Dr. Vikram Sarabhai, who is considered the father of the Indian space program.
 
• ISRO's primary objective is to advance space technology and use its applications for various national tasks.
 
• Over the past 50 years, ISRO has achieved numerous milestones, including the Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan), which made India the first country to reach Mars orbit in its first attempt.
 
• ISRO has developed several satellite launch vehicles like the Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) and the Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) to place satellites into orbit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation)**

 
 
• ISRO is the space agency of the Government of India, headquartered in Bengaluru.
 
• It was established to harness space technology for national development while pursuing space science research and planetary exploration.
 
• ISRO has launched various satellites for communication, earth observation, and navigation purposes.
 
• Notable missions include the Chandrayaan missions to the Moon and the Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan).
 
 
 
• **HAL (Hindustan Aeronautics Limited)**
 
 
• Established in 1940, HAL is an Indian state-owned aerospace and defense company based in Bengaluru.
 
• It is involved in the design, fabrication, and assembly of aircraft, jet engines, helicopters, and their components.
 
• HAL has played a crucial role in the development of India's aerospace industry.
 
 
 
• **BARC (Bhabha Atomic Research Centre)**
 
 
• BARC is India's premier nuclear research facility headquartered in Mumbai.
 
• It was established in 1954 and is responsible for carrying out research and development in nuclear science and engineering.
 
• BARC's work includes the development of nuclear reactors, fuel cycle technologies, and radiation technologies.
 
 
 
• **DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation)**
 
 
• DRDO is an agency under the Ministry of Defence, responsible for developing technology for use by the Indian military.
 
• Established in 1958, DRDO works on various areas including aeronautics, armaments, electronics, land combat engineering, and naval systems.
 
• DRDO has been instrumental in developing indigenous defense technologies such as the Agni and Prithvi missile series.
